scientific_limitations: Only single concentric annuli of fixed area are optimized, not arbitrary masks.
Only the one-dimensional Gaussian STFT and the prescribed finite Hermite band are treated.
The sharp asymptotics hold for fixed positive area as bandwidth increases.
Historical priority may depend on specialist sampling or observability literature under different terminology.
title: Unique maximin annulus and a sharp \(1/e\) radius law for finite Hermite-band Gaussian concentration
